objective.name: matter.stat
objective.description: Read one matter revision and committed substance dimensions without returning its substance.

#root.role: Return lightweight committed metadata for one matter.

total_lines._comment: Present only for line-framed brique substance.

transformation_contract.morphing: A matter identity becomes a lightweight committed revision and size view.
invariants: Byte size is canonical; line count is supplementary and only exists in lines framing.
Descriptor and substance metadata are observed under the matter read lock.
failure: Refuses unknown matters and invalid framing metadata.
